name: AK Turnip 1.13 Rutabaga
description: AK Turnip 1.13 Rutabaga: AK Turnip 1.13 plus native KGSL timeline synchronization. Timeline semaphores, binary semaphores, fences and queue submits use KGSL kernel timelines (IOCTL_KGSL_TIMELINE_*) instead of the emulated vk_sync_timeline + deferred-submit path, so vkQueueSubmit goes straight to the kernel and the driver no longer tracks/polls emulated timeline points on the CPU. Based on draft Mesa MR !39751, with fixes for a per-submit profiling leak, sync_file import (fd leak, dup failure) and CPU waits/signals on imported Android/WSI fences. Falls back to the 1.13 sync path on kernels without KGSL timelines. Built with platform-sdk-version=33.
author: aydar
